review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 7 physical pages against the OCR Markdown (HTML tags stripped, hyphenated line breaks un-joined, inline math marked). No code fences exist in the source. Every hyphenated score group and decimal in Tables 1-3 was compared as a multiset and matches the PDF text exactly. All bracketed citation years ([2024] x5, [2025] x4, [2023] x2, [2021] x1) match; the fifth 2025 on page 1 is the arXiv stamp. References, contributor lists and both sponsor/corresponding-author lines are present. Physical page 3 was rendered at 120 dpi to verify Table 1's printed cell layout, where the bold sub-labels 'Dynamic and Artistic Elements:', 'Anime Style:' and 'Color Aesthetic:' each end a printed line that OCR glued to the following text.
